newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE CUTS FRN SPREADS, T-BILL RATES FROM JAN 17.
newsitem.headline: GREECE CUTS FRN SPREADS, T-BILL RATES FROM JAN 17.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry will cut its three-, six-month T-bill rates by 20 basis points to 10.30 and 10 percent respectively and its 12-month T-bill rate by 10 basis points to 11.10 percent effective January 17.
The finance ministry also said it slashed spreads on three-, five- and seven-year FRNs by 10 basis points to 0.30 percent, 0.80 percent and 1.30 percent respectively from January 17.
An auction of three-year coupon bonds and seven-year floaters will be held on January 24, it said.
Details of the terms of the auction will be announced later on. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
